title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs
authors_zh: Aohan Zeng, Mingdao Liu, Rui Lu, Bowen Wang, Xiao Liu, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: 多环境代理示范数据集与监督微调研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建文本代理 SFT、审计思考—动作—观察记录和研究跨环境迁移的读者。
one_line: AgentInstruct releases 1,866 reward-filtered, multi-turn ReAct demonstrations across six agent tasks for hybrid instruction tuning.
AgentInstruct 将六类代理环境整理成 1,866 条按奖励筛选的多轮 ReAct 示范，用于与通用对话混合微调。
why: It turns interactive thought-action-observation behavior into a small, inspectable SFT object and tests whether that object transfers beyond its source environments.
inclusion_reason: AgentInstruct is an openly readable collection of serialized ReAct demonstrations with explicit teacher authorship, environmental reward filtering, and a documented SFT consumer.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open LLMs could follow ordinary instructions yet repeatedly emitted invalid actions, duplicated commands, or refusals when placed in interactive agent tasks; tuning one specialized environment did not establish transferable agent behavior and could erode general language capability.

AgentTuning addresses this by releasing AgentInstruct, 1,866 reward-filtered ReAct conversations from six environments, and mixing them with general conversations for supervised fine-tuning. The direct output is a static set of instructions, thoughts, actions, observations, corrections, and terminal decisions rather than only an agent scaffold.

L4 facts: Primary source ACL Anthology; Findings of ACL 2024, 11-16 August 2024; decision boundary is serialized SFT demonstrations rather than environment-only episodes; atlas relevance is reward-filtered tool reasoning; data object is a multi-turn ReAct conversation; collected as an L4 Card after proceedings, public splits, actual records, reward rules, and access terms were checked.

开放模型虽然能完成普通指令，却常在交互式代理任务中输出无效动作、重复命令或拒答；只针对单一环境调优既难以形成可迁移的代理行为，也可能损害通用语言能力。

AgentTuning 为此发布 AgentInstruct，将六种环境中的 1,866 条 ReAct 对话按奖励过滤，再与通用对话混合做监督微调。直接产物是包含指令、思考、动作、观察、纠错和终止决定的静态记录，而不只是代理脚手架。

L4 事实：主来源为 ACL Anthology；正式发表于 Findings of ACL 2024，日期为 2024 年 8 月 11 至 16 日；边界是可用于 SFT 的序列化示范，而非仅有环境回合；本图谱关注按奖励筛选的工具推理；数据对象为多轮 ReAct 对话；已核验正式论文、公开分片、实际记录、奖励规则和访问条款后收录为 L4。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AgentTuning makes multi-environment agent behavior trainable by recording GPT-authored ReAct trajectories, retaining them with task rewards, and mixing them with general dialogue so the student learns agent actions without abandoning broad language behavior. Compared with single-task agent tuning, the changed object is a six-task demonstration mixture; task environments judge completion, while the released conversations, not the online environments, are the category-defining artifact.

Google Scholar citations: 373（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=AgentTuning%3A+Enabling+Generalized+Agent+Abilities+for+LLMs&author=Aohan+Zeng&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: AgentInstruct Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/AgentInstruct Scale: 1,866 trajectories from 35,341 candidate instructions; 8,042,511 uncompressed bytes in the current six-split dataset card Record form: id plus conversations containing speaker, loss mask, and value; values serialize instructions, Think/Thought, actions, observations, corrections, and terminal answers File / storage format: six Parquet files for os, db, alfworld, webshop, kg, and mind2web Domains / languages: English; operating systems, databases, household text worlds, shopping, knowledge graphs, and web navigation Construction and filtering: GPT-4 or GPT-3.5 interacts under ReAct; task rewards keep full successes, except Mind2Web accepts reward >= 2/3 License / access constraints: public and non-gated under Hugging Face Terms; no dataset-specific license is declared, and upstream task terms remain applicable Intended use: supervised fine-tuning and mixed-domain agent instruction tuning

AgentTuning 把 GPT 编写的多环境 ReAct 轨迹记录下来，用任务奖励筛选，再与通用对话混合，使学生模型在学习代理动作时不放弃通用语言能力。相较于单任务代理调优，真正改变的是由六类任务组成的示范混合；环境负责判断任务是否完成，而决定分类的是公开对话记录，不是在线环境本身。

开放数据集：是 数据集名称：AgentInstruct 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/AgentInstruct 规模：从 35,341 条候选指令中保留 1,866 条轨迹；当前六分片数据卡标注解压后为 8,042,511 字节 记录形式：每条含编号与对话数组，对话保存说话方、损失掩码和值；值中序列化指令、思考、动作、观察、纠错和终止答案 文件与存储格式：六个 Parquet 文件，分别对应操作系统、数据库、ALFWorld、WebShop、知识图谱和 Mind2Web 领域与语言：英语；覆盖操作系统、数据库、家务文本环境、购物、知识图谱和网页导航 构造与筛选：GPT-4 或 GPT-3.5 按 ReAct 与环境交互；多数任务只保留满奖励轨迹，Mind2Web 的门槛为奖励不低于三分之二 许可与访问限制：数据公开且无需门禁，受 Hugging Face 条款约束；数据集未单独声明许可，上游任务条款仍然适用 预期用途：监督微调，以及代理指令与通用指令的混合训练

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 — Build task instructions. Input: Training splits from four existing agent tasks plus operating-system and database domains without suitable instruction sets. Operation: Reuse source training instructions where available; apply Task Derivation and GPT-4 Self-Instruct to create OS and database tasks and reference solutions. Output and transition: A pool of 35,341 candidate task instructions enters environment interaction. Check / stop rule: Keep derived instructions only when independent execution or reference-answer comparison is consistent; otherwise discard them.

Step 2 — Generate interaction demonstrations. Input: One candidate instruction, a successful one-shot example, GPT-4-0613 or GPT-3.5-turbo-0613, and the task environment. Operation: The teacher alternates a ReAct thought and one action with environment observations; GPT-4 adds thoughts to derived trajectories that originally lack them. Output and transition: A conversation history with a final task reward is sent to filtering. Check / stop rule: Stop on success, token limit, or three identical consecutive outputs; invalid action strings are aligned to available actions with BLEU.

Step 3 — Filter and serialize AgentInstruct. Input: Generated conversations and task-specific reward functions. Operation: Apply the completion threshold, preserve speaker turns and loss masks, and package accepted traces by domain. Output and transition: Six public Parquet splits totaling 1,866 SFT demonstrations enter mixture training. Check / stop rule: Require reward 1 for most tasks and reward >= 2/3 for Mind2Web; reject lower-scoring episodes.

Step 4 — Train and evaluate AgentLM. Input: AgentInstruct, English ShareGPT conversations, and Llama-2-chat at 7B, 13B, or 70B. Operation: Optimize the mixed next-token objective with an agent/general ratio chosen by grid search, then evaluate six held-in, six held-out, and four general tasks. Output and transition: AgentLM checkpoints and controlled evidence about transfer and retained general ability. Check / stop rule: Model selection uses held-in, held-out, and general-task behavior; the paper does not define a single automatic early-stop threshold.

Reproducibility: verify the ACL version, six Parquet revisions, source-task versions, GPT API snapshots, reward definitions, ShareGPT snapshot, mixture ratio, context truncation, and environment versions. Total teacher calls, token cost, random seeds for generation, and one aggregate compute budget are not reported.

步骤 1——建立任务指令。 输入：四类既有代理任务的训练分片，以及缺少合适指令集的操作系统和数据库领域。 操作：有训练指令时直接复用；对操作系统和数据库任务使用任务派生与 GPT-4 自指令方法，生成任务和参考解。 输出并进入下一步：得到 35,341 条候选任务指令，送入环境交互阶段。 检查与停止规则：派生指令只有在独立执行或参考答案比较一致时才保留，否则丢弃。

步骤 2——生成交互示范。 输入：一条候选指令、一个成功的单样例、GPT-4-0613 或 GPT-3.5-turbo-0613，以及对应任务环境。 操作：教师按 ReAct 交替生成思考和单个动作，并接收环境观察；对原本没有思考的派生轨迹，再由 GPT-4 补写思考。 输出并进入下一步：形成带最终任务奖励的对话历史，送入筛选阶段。 检查与停止规则：成功、达到词元上限或连续三次输出相同时停止；无效动作字符串用 BLEU 对齐到可用动作。

步骤 3——筛选并序列化 AgentInstruct。 输入：生成的对话和各任务的奖励函数。 操作：应用完成门槛，保留说话方和损失掩码，并按领域封装通过的轨迹。 输出并进入下一步：六个公开 Parquet 分片共 1,866 条 SFT 示范，进入混合训练。 检查与停止规则：多数任务要求奖励为 1，Mind2Web 要求奖励不低于三分之二；低于门槛的回合删除。

步骤 4——训练并评测 AgentLM。 输入：AgentInstruct、英语 ShareGPT 对话，以及 7B、13B 或 70B 的 Llama-2-chat。 操作：按网格搜索得到的代理数据与通用数据比例优化下一词元目标，再评测六个同域任务、六个未见任务和四个通用任务。 输出并进入下一步：得到 AgentLM 检查点，以及关于迁移能力和通用能力保留情况的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：模型选择综合同域、未见和通用任务表现；论文没有给出单一的自动早停阈值。

可复现性：需要固定 ACL 版本、六个 Parquet 修订版、上游任务版本、GPT 接口快照、奖励定义、ShareGPT 快照、混合比例、上下文截断和环境版本。论文未汇总教师调用次数、词元费用、生成随机种子和总计算预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The decisive transfer comparison keeps the Llama-2-chat backbone family and evaluates the same six held-out tasks before and after AgentTuning. At 70B, the normalized held-out overall score rises from 0.51 to 1.40 (+176%); MiniWoB++ rises from 0.7 to 60.7, while the general-task normalized score changes from 0.95 to 0.96 (Table 3). This supports transfer beyond the six training environments without a measured aggregate general-capability loss, but it does not isolate teacher strength or prove transfer to substantially harder worlds.

The quality ablation compares unfiltered traces with filtered traces and with filtered traces plus CoT on the 7B setup. Held-out normalized score moves from 0.47 to 0.56 after reward filtering and to 0.65 when CoT is retained (Table 2), while held-in moves from 1.34 to 1.38 to 1.96. This supports the paper's filtering-and-rationale contract in this dataset, but reward-level correctness still does not validate every thought step.

决定迁移主张的比较固定 Llama-2-chat 主干家族，并在 AgentTuning 前后评测同一组六个未见任务。70B 模型的未见任务归一化总分从 0.51 升到 1.40，增幅为 176%；MiniWoB++ 从 0.7 升到 60.7，而通用任务归一化总分从 0.95 变为 0.96，见表 3。这说明能力可以迁移到六个训练环境之外，且没有测得汇总通用能力下降，但仍未隔离教师强度，也不能证明对显著更难环境的迁移。

质量消融在 7B 配置下比较未筛选轨迹、奖励筛选轨迹，以及保留思维链的筛选轨迹。未见任务归一化分数依次从 0.47 升到 0.56 和 0.65，同域分数从 1.34 升到 1.38 和 1.96，见表 2。这支持该数据集中的奖励筛选与推理文本保留契约，但任务奖励正确仍不能验证每个思考步骤。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier agent fine-tuning usually targeted one environment or treated an agent framework as the main intervention, leaving cross-task transfer and general-language retention unresolved. AgentTuning changes the training object to a small six-task mixture of complete, reward-filtered ReAct conversations and jointly samples general dialogue during SFT. This makes trajectory diversity and mixture ratio auditable decisions rather than incidental logs. ReAct, GPT teachers, task rewards, and next-token SFT are not themselves new.
更早的代理微调通常只面向一个环境，或把代理框架本身当作主要干预，因此没有解决跨任务迁移和通用语言能力保留问题。AgentTuning 把训练对象改为由六类任务组成的小规模完整 ReAct 对话混合，并按任务奖励筛选，同时在 SFT 中采样通用对话。这样一来，轨迹多样性和混合比例成为可审计的决策，而不是偶然留下的日志。ReAct、GPT 教师、任务奖励和下一词元监督训练本身并非新贡献。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Author-stated limitation: six training and six held-out tasks cover a narrow fraction of possible agent environments, so the transfer claim may fail on complex settings such as Minecraft. Reuse should add domain-held-out environments before calling the dataset general.
  1. Author-stated limitation: demonstrations depend on proprietary GPT-4/GPT-3.5 teachers, which constrains regeneration and can cap students below teacher behavior. Reuse should pin API versions and compare at least one independent teacher or self-distilled source.
  1. Curator audit risk: final rewards filter outcomes, not rationale faithfulness, and the release declares no dataset-specific license. Reuse should manually audit intermediate steps and resolve upstream task and platform terms before redistribution.

1. 作者明确指出：六个训练任务和六个未见任务只覆盖代理环境的一小部分，因此迁移结论可能在 Minecraft 等复杂环境中失效。复用时应增加按领域留出的新环境，再把数据称为通用代理数据。
  1. 作者明确指出：示范依赖闭源的 GPT-4 与 GPT-3.5 教师，既限制精确再生成，也可能使学生受制于教师行为上限。复用时应固定接口版本，并至少加入一个独立教师或自蒸馏来源做对照。
  1. 策展审计风险：最终奖励只筛选结果，不验证推理文本是否忠实，而且发布页没有声明数据集专用许可。复用前应人工抽查中间步骤，并解决上游任务和平台条款后再分发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For an agent-SFT builder with compatible text environments, use the six public splits as a compact baseline mixture and preserve speaker, loss-mask, action, and observation boundaries. The output is an SFT set whose success should be checked on both source and domain-held-out environments; do not use it unchanged when task rewards are unavailable.
  • For a data auditor, replay a stratified sample against pinned environment versions, measure reward false positives, repeated-action failures, and intermediate-step errors, and report results per source split. The output is a reproducibility report; do not infer step correctness from a terminal pass alone.

• 对拥有兼容文本环境的代理 SFT 构建者，可把六个公开分片作为紧凑的基线混合，并保留说话方、损失掩码、动作和观察边界。输出是可训练的 SFT 集，成功标准应同时覆盖源环境和按领域留出的环境；若任务没有可靠奖励，就不应原样套用。
  • 对数据审计者，可在固定环境版本上分层重放样本，测量奖励假阳性、重复动作失败和中间步骤错误，并按来源分片报告。输出是复现报告；不能因终局通过就推断每个步骤正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: AgentTuning answers weak open-model agent behavior with 1,866 reward-filtered, multi-environment ReAct demonstrations.
  • Method handle: instruction construction, GPT interaction, reward filtering, and agent/general mixture training are the four decisions; reward filtering determines admission.
  • Data handle: six non-gated Parquet splits expose id and conversation turns with loss masks, thoughts, actions, observations, and terminal answers; no dataset-specific license is declared.
  • Evidence anchor: Llama-2-chat-70B moves from 0.51 to 1.40 on the normalized held-out aggregate while its general aggregate remains 0.95 versus 0.96.
  • Reuse decision: suitable as a compact text-agent SFT baseline; before reuse, replay samples and resolve upstream terms because terminal reward does not certify the rationale.

• 一句话定位：AgentTuning 用 1,866 条按奖励筛选的多环境 ReAct 示范，解决开放模型代理行为薄弱的问题。
  • 方法抓手：指令构造、GPT 交互、奖励筛选和代理数据与通用数据混合是四个关键决策，其中奖励筛选决定样本能否进入训练集。
  • 数据抓手：六个无需门禁的 Parquet 分片公开编号、带损失掩码的对话轮次、思考、动作、观察和终止答案；发布页没有声明数据集专用许可。
  • 证据锚点：Llama-2-chat-70B 的未见任务归一化总分从 0.51 升到 1.40，通用任务总分则从 0.95 变为 0.96。
  • 复用决定：适合作为紧凑的文本代理 SFT 基线；复用前必须重放抽样并解决上游条款，因为终局奖励不能证明推理过程正确。
